title: TSS Transformation Protocol
author: Lutz LCB Berwanger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qtndwme

steps.title: Prepare 2x TSS Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Transformation and Storage Solution (2x TSS) by combining the following components to a final volume of 100 mL in LB medium, adjusting to pH 6.5:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 g PEG (3350 or 8000) to achieve 20% (w/v).
Add 10 mL DMSO (after autoclave) to achieve 10% (v/v).
Add 2.03 g MgCl2 * 6H2O to achieve 100 mM.

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a starter culture using 1.5 mL LB medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1.5 – 2 hours until the culture becomes turbid, indicating exponential growth.

steps.title: Prepare Transformation Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the culture and TSS on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the culture to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Add Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Add the plasmid to the mixture on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 – 1.0 µL of plasmid (use 0.3 µL for high copy plasmids).

steps.title: Incubate Mixture
steps.instruction: Perform sequential incubations to allow for transformation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 45-60 min at 37°C on a shaking device (> 200 rpm) without adding LB.

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Plate the transformed cells onto LB-Agar containing the appropriate antibiotic.
